Defined in: [packages/ai/src/activities/generate3dModel/index.ts:656](https://github.com/TanStack/ai/blob/main/packages/ai/src/activities/generate3dModel/index.ts#L656)

**`Experimental`**

Read the status of a 3D model job that [generate3dModel](generate3dModel.md) submitted.
When the job is completed, it also reads the finished model.

It runs no middleware. To observe the full lifecycle, use `wait: true` or
`stream: true` on [generate3dModel](generate3dModel.md).

## Type Parameters

`TAdapter` *extends* [`Model3dAdapter`](../interfaces/Model3dAdapter.md)\<`string`, `any`, `any`, `any`\>

## Example

**Poll a submitted job**

```ts
import { generate3dModel, get3dModelJobStatus } from '@tanstack/ai'
import { fal3dModel } from '@tanstack/ai-fal'

const adapter = fal3dModel('fal-ai/hunyuan3d-v3/image-to-3d')
const { jobId } = await generate3dModel({ adapter, prompt, threadId })

const status = await get3dModelJobStatus({ adapter, jobId })
if (status.result) console.log(status.result.url)
```

 3D model generation is experimental and may change.
